name: Luton

queries.query: site:gov.uk HM Land Registry Luton cadastral parcel polygons map API
queries.result: First-party discovery identified HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons as the open England-and-Wales source for indicative registered-freehold property polygons, with monthly local-authority GML downloads. Luton Borough Council planning and land-charges pages were found, but no local cadastral parcel API was evidenced.

queries.query: Luton cadastral parcels official map HM Land Registry open data
queries.result: The United Kingdom local/native language is English; this distinct query also found the official HM Land Registry INSPIRE source and Luton Borough Council land-charges procedure. No separate municipal cadastral custodian or parcel API was evidenced.

registryBasis: HM Land Registry is the evidenced national land-registration and cadastral custodian for England and Wales and publishes the INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset. Luton Borough Council is evidenced only for local planning/land-charges procedures, not as a cadastral parcel custodian.

requests.outcome: Official guidance returned. It describes open INSPIRE Index Polygons for registered freehold property in England and Wales, monthly updates, GML delivery, and a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE identifier; polygon extents are indicative rather than title-plan boundaries.
National Data Library record returned. It attributes the dataset to HM Land Registry and states that files are divided by local-authority area in England and Wales under the Open Government Licence.
Anonymous request redirected back to the same download route repeatedly and stopped at the bounded redirect limit. No GML file, schema payload, or parcel geometry was fabricated or retained.
Official INSPIRE WMS capabilities returned. The service advertises layer inspire:CP.CadastralParcel and CRS metadata; the cadastral-parcel layer is queryable=0.

Bounded anonymous GetMap returned a PNG for an EPSG:27700 extent around Luton. It is visual map evidence only; no native parcel IDs or unchanged full polygon geometry were returned, so no sample was retained.
Service response reported WFS disabled. No feature request was attempted after that response.

Luton Borough Council local land-charges page returned. It documents an official local search service for charges against a property or parcel, but does not evidence an anonymous cadastral parcel map/API.

source: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons spatial data

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons covers indicative positions and extents of registered freehold property in England and Wales, distributed by local-authority area.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official guidance, catalogue metadata, WMS capabilities, and a bounded WMS map response were verified; no Luton GML file or feature geometry response was obtained.

runtimeReadinessReason: The source is real and public, but this attempt did not qualify a bounded Luton feature response with native IDs and geometry or an independently reviewed adapter. This packet is not source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: The current Luton local-authority GML download URL and exact file schema were not retrieved because the public download route redirected repeatedly. INSPIRE is an indicative registered-freehold subset, not a complete cadastral fabric; leasehold and unregistered land are outside this open subset. The WUP point was preserved and was not used as evidence of absence.
